crisisBoundary: BPD Companion is not crisis support. If you might hurt yourself or someone else, contact local emergency services or a crisis line now.
notTherapy: This app supports reflection and skills practice. It does not replace therapy, medical care, or emergency support.

calmResponses: You're safe right now. Let's take this one moment at a time.
This feeling is intense, but it will pass. You've made it through before.
Right now, nothing needs to be decided. Just breathe.

compassion: This urge makes sense. It comes from a real need inside you.
You can feel this urge without obeying it. It will pass.
The urge can pass without you obeying it.
Urges peak and fade. You only need to wait, not act.
This is your nervous system talking. You can hear it without following it.

delayEncouragement.5: Five minutes of space is a gift to yourself.
delayEncouragement.10: Ten minutes is enough for most urges to soften.
